Browser extra_wait adds additional time after network_idle to ensure all async operations complete

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { browser: { extraWait: 200, mode: "always", wait: "network_idle" } };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await scrape(engine, url);
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
